utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, just send me the first repair when you have it and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still waiting on the first one, but I heard they’re collecting tools and supplies over by the community hall, and a few folks said they’d help sort everything this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can head over this afternoon, if that works. Just tell me what time and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s today at the community center. I’m getting the repair station set up there, and I could use help with the tools and sorting supplies when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll bring the tools and help sort the supplies when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m lining up the first houses now. Send me any updates from your side and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can handle assigning the first few houses and matching people to the smaller fixes, then I’ll send you the updated list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the house list and the timing, so the main thing is to keep me posted on any updates as soon as you have them. If you can take one of the first houses or help with contact follow-up, that would keep us from stepping on each other.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over a bit early for setup, and I’ll keep you posted on any timing or house-list updates right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you bring the tools and help me sort the supplies when you get there? We’re still set for today at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’ll bring the tools and help sort the supplies when I get there. I’m still set for today at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What still needs doing, and where can I help? I’ve got a few tools and can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren. I’m still finalizing the house list and setup at the community center on Sunday, so I can use help with prep and checking in on a few homes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over a bit early to help set up, and I’ll make sure everyone knows when and where the repair drive is.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Around 10 works for me. Are you still starting at the school lot?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but I can pass along anything I get. What’s changed on the house list or timing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly just the usual shuffle for now, but I need the latest house list before I lock anything in. If you hear a change, send it over right away so I can keep the timing straight.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
